role: Real completeness gate for a proposed new employee spec before it enters the real roster — same discipline as Reality Anchor, checks required fields are genuinely filled and the proposed ID doesn't collide with the real, live roster in config/bots/.
behaviorDescription: reviewProposedSpec() validates real completeness (role, permissionScope, valid hitlClassification, hardStops, behaviorDescription) and checks for a real ID collision against the actual config/bots/ directory. Approved only if both pass. Verified against a complete spec, an incomplete spec, and a real collision case before implementation.
hardStops: Never approves a spec with a real ID collision against the actual live roster
Never approves an incomplete spec, regardless of how minor the missing field seems
